SELECT T1.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T1.VDATE vdate, T1.MDATE mdate, /*T6.TYPE_6 assetType1,*/
T6.TYPE_9 assetType1, T6.TYPE_10 assetType10, T6.TYPE_11 assetType11,
T1.CCY ccy, T1.FINPROD_ID finprodId, T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, T3.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, T1.PS ps, T1.ENTRUST_AMT entrustAmt, T1.ENTRUST_NUM entrustNum, T1.PRO_AVAILABLE_CASH proAvailableCash, T1.ACC_AVAILABLE_CASH accAvailableCash, T1.REMARK remark, T1.COUNTER_ID counterId, T1.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader, T1.CONTACT_INFO contactInfo, T2.TRADER trader, T1.INV_MANAGER_ID invManagerId FROM ETR_ENTRUST T1 LEFT JOIN ETR_DISTRIBUTE T2 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T2.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T6 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T6.FINPROD_ID
T1.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}
select /*TYPE_6 assetType1*/ TYPE_9 assetType1, TYPE_11 assetType11, TYPE_10 assetType10 from FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE where FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
